title: Full BEGINNERS/INTERMEDIATE Ballet Class for a Small Space | FOLLOW ALONG | Nataliya Bondar-Shelest

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor guides students through each movement with precise verbal terminology and hand demonstrations. She combines professional dance experience with clear instruction focusing on classical ballet technique.

lesson_structure.note: Warm up exercises starting with feet and ankle movement.
Explanation and demonstration of barre combinations.
Detailed breakdown of plie combination with arm positions.

steps_taught.name: demi plie
steps_taught.description: Half bend of the knees keeping heels on the floor.

steps_taught.name: grand plie
steps_taught.description: Full bend of the knees allowing heels to rise in certain positions.

steps_taught.name: releve
steps_taught.description: Rising onto the balls of the feet.

what_works: Clear verbal explanation combined with hand demonstration before execution.
what_hinders: Limited multi-angle demonstrations for foot placement.

quotes.text: This class combines my professional dance experience with my teaching experience.
We will be starting with warmup.
In this class I will first explain each combination and demonstrate it with my hands.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor introduces herself while sitting in front of the ballet barre.
Instructor demonstrates foot articulation and demi pointes at the barre.
Instructor demonstrates arm positions and plie variations facing the camera without the barre.

extraction.distinctive_method: Explaining and demonstrating every exercise with hands first before performing it to music.
